title: Copy First, Translate Later: Interpreting Translation Dynamics in Multilingual Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2604.17633v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models exhibit impressive cross-lingual capabilities. However, prior work analyzes this phenomenon through isolated factors and at sparse points during training, limiting our understanding of how cross-lingual generalization emerges--particularly in the early phases of learning. To study the early trajectory of linguistic and translation capabilities, we pretrain a multilingual 1.7B model on nine diverse languages, capturing checkpoints at a much finer granularity. We use word-level translation as a testbed, introducing a novel dataset to trace how translation develops over training through behavioral analyses, model-component analysis, and parameter-based ablations. translated_title: 先复制，后翻译：解读多语言预训练中的翻译动力学
translated_abstract: 大语言模型展现出令人印象深刻的跨语言能力。然而，以往的工作通过孤立的因素和训练过程中稀疏的观察点来分析这一现象，限制了我们对跨语言泛化如何产生的理解——尤其是在学习的早期阶段。为了研究语言能力与翻译能力的早期发展轨迹，我们在九种不同的语言上预训练了一个多语言17亿（1.7B）参数模型，并以更细的粒度捕获训练检查点。我们以词级翻译作为测试平台，引入了一个新颖的数据集，通过行为分析、模型组件分析和基于参数的消融实验，追踪翻译能力在训练过程中的发展。我们发现，模型在快速获得基本语言能力的同时学会了词元级别的复制，而翻译能力的发展则分为两个截然不同的阶段：初始阶段以复制和表层相似性为主导，第二个阶段中……
tldr: 该研究通过对一个1.7B模型在九种语言上进行细粒度检查点的预训练分析，揭示多语言翻译能力的发展分为两个阶段：早期以词元复制和表层相似性为主，后期才逐步形成真正的翻译能力。
en_tdlr: By pretraining a 1.7B multilingual model on nine languages with fine-grained checkpoints, this study reveals that translation capability emerges in two distinct phases: an early phase dominated by token copying and surface-level similarity, followed by a later phase of genuine translation development.
